f001eb36771bbcd97a474da387f52f741ba33846.scope: Three actual acquisitions of an existing owner-qualified fixture; not an application corpus, popularity sample or latency service-level guarantee.
f001eb36771bbcd97a474da387f52f741ba33846.acquisition: Fresh context inspection, offline analysis, native acquisition and reconciliation measured separately. Up to three bounded attempts; stale attempts remain in the report. No candidate execution or application-value sampling.
f001eb36771bbcd97a474da387f52f741ba33846.bytes: Canonical contract, native evidence and plan serialization plus actual exported one-query closure and disposable cache file contents. Filesystem blocks, install payloads and connection credentials are excluded.
f001eb36771bbcd97a474da387f52f741ba33846.cache: Cold lookup opens a new cache object against existing files; warm lookups reuse an object. Neither drops OS page caches or claims current remote freshness. All recorded lookups must remain unverified.
f001eb36771bbcd97a474da387f52f741ba33846.environment: Owner fixtures may already have warmed driver/server state; SDK ownership and transport boundaries remain adapter-specific. Compare only the declared environment, not engines as universal performance rankings.
